meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.FracInternal.SpaceGradient.tra: Lean defines the Fourier transform by an integral that has a default value when integrability fails; this declaration concerns that default, not a classical Fourier inversion assertion.
notes.Breakdown.axialRotation: This is a choice based definition with the identity isometry as fallback; the separate rotation specification proves that the intended formula is available.
notes.Breakdown.fracUniqueness_of: A partial namespace end retains Breakdown; the lexical inventory dropped that remaining namespace.
